Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The filer (qualifying surviving spouse) is claimed as a dependent on someone else's return and cannot take the deduction (i1040gi p. 98, Line 21, "You can take this deduction only if all of the following apply ... Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.
